method: After all 7 fixture cases were sent in one conversation, the banner kind for every message was read (preReloadKinds). The app was then navigated away and back (in-session history reopen, re-fetching GET /conversations/:id/messages) and the banner kinds re-read (postReopenKinds).
architectureNote: This frontend has no multi-conversation list/browse UI -- a single active conversation is tracked via localStorage.tinaConversationId. Reopen means navigating away and back within the same authenticated session, which triggers a genuine re-fetch and re-hydration of persisted messages.
verdict: PASS -- all 7 fixture-case trust banner kinds (plus the null welcome message) are byte-identical before and after history reopen. browserHistoryReopenValidated=true is fully supported for every canonical state, not just one.
